title: Consistent Relexicalization of Clinical Documents using Graph-Based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.21387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Relexicalization is a pivotal technique in clinical NLP, as it facilitates robust masking of sensitive information while synthesizing datasets that retain high-fidelity, real-world characteristics. However, preserving structural integrity, relational coherence, and temporal consistency during transformation remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches frequently rely on independent entity replacement, which results in clinical inconsistencies across longitudinal records. This reduces the value of such relexicalized datasets for downstream scientific analysis. To address these limitations, we introduce G-RELIC (Graph Based Contextual Relexicalization with Improved Consistency) which combines the power of LLMs with graphs. G-RELIC implements a graph-based mapping mechanism which optimizes for one-to-one correspondence between original and surrogate entities. translated_title: 基于图方法实现临床文档的一致性再词汇化
translated_abstract: 再词汇化是临床自然语言处理中的一项关键技术，它能够在合成保留高保真度、真实世界特征的数据集的同时，实现对敏感信息的稳健掩蔽。然而，在转换过程中保持结构完整性、关系连贯性和时间一致性仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法通常依赖于独立的实体替换，这会导致纵向记录中的临床不一致性，从而降低了此类再词汇化数据集在下游科学分析中的价值。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了G-RELIC（基于图的上下文再词汇化改进一致性方法），它将大语言模型（LLM）的强大能力与图结构相结合。G-RELIC实现了一种基于图的映射机制，该机制优化原始实体与替代实体之间的一一对应关系。它还引入了一种确定性的时间重定位算法，以保持时间信息的一致性。
tldr: 该论文提出G-RELIC方法，通过将大语言模型与基于图的映射机制和确定性时间重定位算法相结合，确保原始实体与替代实体之间的一一对应关系，从而在临床文档再词汇化过程中保持结构完整性、关系连贯性和时间一致性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces G-RELIC, which combines LLMs with a graph-based mapping mechanism and a deterministic temporal repositioning algorithm to ensure one-to-one correspondence between original and surrogate entities, achieving consistent relexicalization of clinical documents with preserved structural, relational, and temporal integrity.
